serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: You attacked me and stole from me! Are you going to just pretend that it never happened?!
Hobo: I didn’t have a choice, ok?! Look at me! I’m a mess dude.
You: Give me back my shit! I saved you! You could do at least that much.
Hobo: It’s gone dude. Living costs money.
